research.notes: Legal name left null: no cited page shows 'Purple Communications, Inc.'; site footers name ZP Better Together, LLC as parent/copyright holder. No registry IDs (EIN, CA entity number, UEI) were verified. No general email found on the contact page. Agenda once spells vendor 'Purpose Communications' (typo).

profile.summary: Purple Communications provides American Sign Language interpreting and captioning services, including on-site interpreting, video remote interpreting and real-time captioning (CART), for businesses, government agencies, medical settings and schools. It also offers video relay services. It operates under the Purple brand as part of ZP Better Together, LLC.

sources.title: Purple Communications - American Sign Language Interpreting - Business Solutions

review.notes: Purple Communications (ASL interpreting, VRI, CART, VRS) at an Austin, TX address matches the agenda location and fits OUSD's interpretation and risk-management accommodation contracts; the ZP Better Together parent relationship and all contact fields are shown on the cited pages. The summary is neutral and supported, though I could not find an OUSD document naming Purple as the RFP 22-139OE awardee.
